contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

irreducible_factors_ascending.canonicalization: sorted by degree then coefficient list
irreducible_factors_ascending.definition: monic irreducible GF(2) factors whose product is input

rabin_certificates.canonicalization: aligned with factors; primes increasing, gcd checks aligned

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: All GF(2) polynomials are ascending bit lists with coefficients 0 or 1, no trailing zero, and monic. Factors are sorted by (degree, coefficient list). Their product must equal the input polynomial.

For a factor q of degree d, prime_divisors is the increasing list of distinct primes dividing d; frobenius_full is the canonical remainder x^(2^d) mod q; gcd_checks[r-index] is the monic ascending gcd(x^(2^(d/r))-x,q).
Rabin irreducibility requires frobenius_full=x and every gcd_check=1. Certificate entries align one-to-one with the sorted factors.
